# Wird

> Wird is a calm daily companion for the five prayers, the Quran and small daily habits, for iPhone and iPad. A living tree grows when you come back and waits when you cannot. Worship is never behind a price: the five prayers, the Quran reader, dhikr, the tree and your history are free for everyone, with no ads on any plan. Wird Plus adds the extras for one adult; Wird Family covers a household with up to five children's iPads. Coming to the App Store. Made in Ontario, Canada.

Support: hello@wirdwellness.app

## Pages

- [Overview](https://www.wirdwellness.app/): what Wird is, the tree, prayer times, the Quran reader, privacy, plans
- [Start](https://www.wirdwellness.app/start/): the short version, with questions and answers
- [Plans](https://www.wirdwellness.app/learn/plans/): what is free, what Wird Plus and Wird Family add, and what they cost
- [Coming back to prayer](https://www.wirdwellness.app/guides/getting-back-into-prayer-after-years-away/): a short, gentle guide for anyone returning after time away
- [Support](https://www.wirdwellness.app/support/): prayer times, reminders, widgets, account and data, plans and payments
- [Privacy](https://www.wirdwellness.app/privacy/): no ads, no tracking, location and recitation stay on the device
- [Terms](https://www.wirdwellness.app/terms/): Apple's standard license, what Wird is and is not, plans and payments

## Facts

- Prices (US dollars, the App Store shows local currency): Wird Plus $4.99 a month, $39.99 a year, or $49.99 once. Wird Family $6.99 a month or $59.99 a year, with a 14-day free trial. Wird Family, forever: $149.99 once, sold only from Ramadan to Eid 2027.
- Nothing is taken away if you stop paying; every prayer, page and journal entry stays readable and exportable.
- No ads on any plan. No third-party analytics or tracking. No account needed.
- The Quran text is the Tanzil Uthmani text; translations come from QuranEnc; hadith are cited from Sahih al-Bukhari and Sahih Muslim by reference. Wird does not issue religious rulings.
